Question: In salat if change sequence of surah in 2 rakat is it OK?(In 1st rakat ' Kul huwallhu ahad???? and second rakat 'Alam tar kif???" or if it is not OK did we have to do sajda e sahu (obligatery sajda)? Answer ID: 13153 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 831/783=B/1430) If the order of the surah was changed forgetfully, there is no wrong, but it is makrooh to do so intentionally. In both the cases, the salah will be valid and no sajdah sahv (remedial prostration) will be required. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
